exposure: at-home influenza diagnosis (home testing, telehealth care)
outcome: feasibility of remote influenza diagnosis and treatment
sensitivity and specificity of home influenza test
cohort: The study included 124 Seattle-area households comprising 481 individuals with children during the 2019-2020 influenza season.
finding: The study demonstrated the feasibility of self-testing for influenza combined with rapid home delivery of antiviral treatment.
